note: Triennial election of the district electoral divisions of Lisburn rural district, one member each, polled on 2 June 1949. All 15 divisions are taken from the returning officer's notice of result (John M. Shirley, returning officer, Rural Council Offices, Dublin Road, Lisburn, dated 3 June 1949; Belfast Telegraph, 6 June 1949, p. 2): only Lambeg was polled; twelve members were sole candidates, and in Ballinderry and Montiaghs, with no nomination, the retiring members were deemed re-elected. No party labels are printed; places of abode are not reproduced. Returned unopposed.
